messages:
Rajesh K: CI alert — linux-builder-3 is red on the proto targets after the toolchain roll last night. Anyone hit this locally?

ci-bot: Build failure: https://ci.redwood/internal/12345 (linux-builder-3)

Maria L: looking now — can you paste the failing log snippet?

Rajesh K: here's the key part: 
```
ERROR: /workspace/proto/BUILD:23:11: Compiling proto sources failed: fatal error: myproto.pb.h: No such file or directory
#include "myproto.pb.h"
         ^~~~~~~~~~~~~
1 error generated.
Target //proto:all failed to build
```

Sam T: that looks like generated headers not on the include path. did the proto generation target change?

Sasha: @Rajesh K which SHA kicked the CI? I can try a local repro on a similar image.

Rajesh K: CI linked the commit 8f3a2c4 (toolchain: bump gcc/ld flags). Not obvious why headers would disappear but the timing matches.

Devon: quick repro command: `bazel build //proto:myproto --sandbox_debug --spawn_strategy=local` — if genrules ran out of order you'll see missing .pb.h locally too.

Maria L: I ran that and see the same. The generated .pb.h is created under bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/proto/_virtual_imports but the cc_proto_library target isn't exporting that include path anymore. Might be an export_includes change in the toolchain or the proto rule wrapper.

Sam T: I bisected locally to a change in //third_party/protobuf:BUILD that updated how include paths are exported. Rolling back that patch fixes the build.

Rajesh K: hmm. Can someone trigger a CI rerun on that specific job while we triage? @ci-bot / @Devon?

Devon: kicked a rerun: `ci-bot rerun 12345` — should show up in a minute.

ci-bot: Rebuild scheduled: https://ci.redwood/internal/12345/rebuild (queued on linux-builder-3)

Sasha: if the rerun comes back green we might be hitting a flake (race in genrule -> header publishing). If it stays red it's deterministic.

(10m later)

ci-bot: Rebuild finished — FAILURE (same error).

Maria L: deterministic then. I can open a quick PR to re-add the export_includes or to make the proto gen rule explicitly add the generated include dir to cc_proto_library. Which is preferable?

Sam T: prefer adjusting the wrapper in third_party/protobuf so all downstream consumers don't have to patch. I can draft a change, but want to discuss with infra if it's safe w/ the toolchain bump.

Rajesh K: tagging @eng-infra — we need a short postmortem for the toolchain roll if the change broke header exports. Also we should add a CI smoke that builds //proto:all after toolchain rolls.

Devon: agree on smoke test. I'll add a flaky label for now and queue a backport PR to revert the wrapper until Sam's fix lands.

Maria L: quick fix (branch in my fork) — adding `export_includes = ["bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/proto/_virtual_imports"]` to the cc_proto_library wrapper makes CI pass locally. I'll open PR and reference the CI failure.

Sam T: can you include a comment pointing to the bisect results and the toolchain commit SHA so we can revert properly later?

Maria L: yes. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4587 — contains temporary export_includes fix and a test.

ci-bot: PR job started for branch maria/proto-export-fix (build 12346)

(20m later)

ci-bot: PR build succeeded and merge checks passed.

Devon: merged the PR, backported to release-x for immediate unblock. :thumbsup:

Rajesh K: thanks everyone. Action items: Sam to prepare a proper wrapper fix + review, Devon to add CI smoke for proto after toolchain rolls, and I'll draft a short incident note on the toolchain roll.

Sasha: I'll watch the next two CI runs for flakiness, and follow up if anything else pops up.

Maria L: closing the loop here — leave thread if anything else crops up but build is green on the builders we care about.

Sam T: I'll pick up the wrapper PR tomorrow morning.

ci-bot: Build status: linux-builder-3 — GREEN (after hotfix).

Rajesh K: marking this resolved for now. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
